_comment: Hand-authored semantic type per golden column (EVALS.md M1 / §4.4).
Authored once against SCOPE.md FR-5's vocabulary and inherited by every
corruption of that golden: corruption never changes a column's intended type.
Three anti-overfit properties are deliberate: `value` and `field3` are
semantically opaque; `code` is `integer` in transactions.csv and `digits` in
inventory.xlsx; `satisfaction` is a 1-5 integer a header-driven guesser would
call categorical. A name->type dictionary therefore cannot score 1.0.
